name: CARBOplatin / PACLitaxel (metastatic)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic platinum/taxane doublet; the backbone is not biomarker-restricted, listed under HER2-negative recurrent/metastatic regimens. Particularly relevant for triple-negative disease (subtype #3) and germline BRCA1/2 carriers (platinum sensitivity). Germline BRCA1/2 status is tested to identify PARP-inhibitor candidates. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-Q 9 of 15.

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling to prevent hypersensitivity.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Assess germline BRCA1/2 status in all patients with recurrent/metastatic breast cancer to identify PARP-inhibitor candidates (BINV-Q).

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 9 of 15. CARBOplatin AUC 6 IV on day 1 (target AUC), every 21 days. Tall-man per ISMP. For germline-BRCA/TNBC single-agent use, carboplatin AUC 6 IV day 1 every 21 to 28 days is also source-stated (same page).

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 9 of 15 (Carboplatin/Paclitaxel: Carboplatin AUC 6 IV Day 1, cycled every 21 days)

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 9 of 15. The guideline states PACLitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2 IV on day 1 every 21 days; dosePerUnit is set to the lower bound (175 mg/m2), full sourced range 175 to 200 mg/m2. Tall-man per ISMP.

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 9 of 15 (Paclitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2 IV Day 1, cycled every 21 days)
